ac480.label: 480 V AC → UPS → 208/415 V AC PDUs (today)

dc800.label: 800 VDC bus: AC/DC front end → DC busway → DC-input racks, battery on bus (forward option)
dc800.window_basis: assumption pending OCP Diablo 400 §9.3.1 / NVIDIA MGX power rack spec

bipolar_400.label: ±400 VDC bipolar, high-resistance midpoint ground (OCP Diablo 400 convention)
bipolar_400.grounding: midpoint of the ±400 V bus tied to ground through a high resistance (HRG): first fault flows a limited current, alarms, does not trip; insulation and clearances sized for 400 V to ground
bipolar_400.imd_arrangement: one insulation monitoring device at the midpoint per rectifier section (pole-to-ground resistance both poles)
bipolar_400.spec: OCP Diablo 400 v0.5.2 / v0.7.0 (±400 VDC, ±0.5 % regulation, 800 V rail-to-rail)

unipolar_800.label: 800 VDC unipolar, return isolated from earth (NVIDIA / OCP LVDC SST v0.3 convention)
unipolar_800.grounding: two-wire 800 VDC with the return isolated from protective earth (IT system): first fault undetected without insulation monitoring, so the IMD is mandatory; insulation and clearances sized for 800 V to ground
unipolar_800.imd_arrangement: two-pole insulation monitoring device (positive and return to earth) per rectifier section, with fault location on the tap-offs
unipolar_800.spec: OCP LVDC SST specification v0.3 (800 VDC unipolar, effective 2026-06-22); Diablo 400 800 VDC two-wire option

rack.label: GB300 NVL72-class liquid rack, 48U MGX, 600 x 1068 x 2236 mm
rack.src: Supermicro / Cisco GB300 NVL72 datasheet 600 W x 1068 D x 2236 H mm; ~1.36-1.5 t loaded (GPU Smith, HPE). Vertiv SmartIT for GB300 is 600 x 1200 D with its rear extension and 2286 mm high: that depth leaves an 800 mm aisle behind a 200 mm plenum in a 2.2 m module and is not used

cdu.label: Row CDU 600 kW (Vertiv CoolChip CDU 600 class), W45 secondary
cdu.src: Vertiv CoolChip CDU 600 product page / brochure: 2000 H x 600 W x 1200 D mm, 480 kg dry / 550 kg wet, 600 kW at 4 K approach

fancoil.label: In-row chilled-water fan coil 300 mm, 20 kW on the 18 °C trim loop
fancoil.src: 300 mm in-row chilled-water class (Schneider InRow RC / Vertiv CRV CW); 20 kW at 18 °C water is a design value, NOT verified. W45 water cannot cool room air, so the residual-air coils run on a trim loop from the skid chiller

ups.label: Galaxy VL UPS frame up to 500 kW, internal N+1 power modules
ups.src: Schneider Galaxy VL brochure footprint 850 W x 925 D mm (GVL200K500DS max depth 925 mm); mass not read (900 kg assumed)

batt.label: Galaxy Lithium-ion battery cabinet, 16 x 2.04 kWh
batt.src: 32.6 kWh per cabinet (catalog PWR-BATT-LI); 200 kW per cabinet from Schneider's Galaxy VL 2000 kW system = 10 cabinets; 600 x 1000 mm footprint and 650 kg not read from the manual (Rev 1 layout value)

swbd.label: 480 V switchboard section 36 in W x 24 in D (Square D QED-2 class), main + maintenance bypass
swbd.src: QED-2 bid specification: 36 in wide x 24 in deep sections; one section to 1,200 A, two sections to 2,500 A (ABB Emax 2000 A needs 60 in depth)

rect.label: AC/DC front-end cabinet 800 VDC (4 x 100 kW)

batt800.label: 800 V class battery cabinet on the bus
